item.title: 'Justice for my father': Jay Pawar seeks arrest of VSR Ventures owner over viral 'sleeping' video
item.description: Jay Ajit Pawar has demanded the immediate arrest of Rohit Singh, owner of VSR Ventures, after a viral video allegedly showed him sleeping in the pilot's seat during a flight. Pawar criticized AAIB report on the Learjet 45 crash that killed his father, former Maharashtra Deputy CM Ajit Pawar,

item.title: Indian mariner killed in Gulf of Oman tanker attack; three US jets downed in friendly fire incident in Kuwait, says CENTCOM
item.description: An Indian national was killed on Monday when an explosive-laden unmanned boat struck an oil tanker off the coast of Muscat Governorate, according to reports. "The Maritime Security Centre reported that the oil tanker MKD VYOM was attacked by an unmanned boat 52 nautical miles off the coast of Muscat Governorate.

item.title: India-Canada ties get boost with $2.6 bn uranium deal, defence dialogue launched
item.description: Describing people-to-people ties as the driving force of bilateral relations, PM Modi said India and Canada share strong democratic values, celebrate diversity and are committed to the welfare of humanity. He added that discussions focused on transforming this shared vision into a next-level partnership.

item.title: Sensex sinks over 1,000 points as US-Iran conflict rattle markets; Nifty below 24,900
item.description: The benchmark Nifty fell 1.24 per cent, or 312.95 points, to settle at 24,865.70. The Sensex dropped 1.29 per cent, or 1,048.34 points, to close at 80,238.85, marking its lowest level since September 2025.

item.title: Happy Holi 2026: Holika Dahan on March 2; when is Rangwali Holi, March 3 or 4? check Shubh Muhurat
item.description: Holi begins with Holika Dahan, when people light bonfires and perform rituals and prayers around the sacred fire. This year, due to a lunar eclipse, there will be a one-day gap: after Choti Holi on March 2, Rangpanchami will be celebrated on March 4.

item.title: Rashmika blushes gazing at Vijay during puja; jumps in joy while greeting crowd; fans call it 'cringe'
item.description: Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda visited their native and performed the Sathyanarayana puja at their new home. Videos and photos from the puja are doing the rounds, and one cannot miss Vijay and Rashmika's adorable chemistry.

item.title: iPhone 17e, iPad Air break covers with faster performance; see what's new, pricing & availability
item.description: iPhone 17e will start at 256GB of storage for Rs 64,900 whereas the new iPad Air starts at just Rs 64,900 for the 11-inch model and Rs 84,900 for the 13-inch model.

item.title: Trump declines to rule out deployment of US troops to Iran​
item.description: Trump's remark about possible troop involvement in the conflict came as the Central Command reported on X that four members of US forces have died as of Monday. ​

item.title: Gold prices rise for 5th day over Middle East tensions
item.description: MCX gold April futures gained 2.53 per cent to Rs 1,66,199 per 10 grams on Monday, while MCX silver May futures eased 0.90 per cent to Rs 2,80,090 per kg.

item.title: Indian stock markets to remain closed on account of Holi
item.description: Trading in equities, equity derivatives, securities lending and borrowing and interest rate derivatives will be suspended for the day, exchanges said on Tuesday. Commodity derivatives will be closed in the morning and open for the evening session.
